content: Simulate a moderately dense debris flow with shear-thinning non-Newtonian material. Please refer to 1.png for geometry. Use debris density of 1700 kg/m^3, initial particle spacing dp = 0.5 m, use Symplectic step algorithm, artificial viscosity 0.1, output time interval 0.2s and run to total time 10s.

================================================================
  SIMULATION PLAN
================================================================

### Reasoning
Used a 2D setup because the reference sketch is a side-view dam-break style debris-flow channel with no lateral variation. Interpreted the image dimensions as an initial debris column 14.5 m wide and 29.5 m high at the left, followed by an additional 85 m horizontal run to the right wall, giving total channel length 99.5 m. Boundary height was set slightly above the initial column at 31 m to contain the flow. Geometry follows the recommended pattern: fluid first, then open-top box walls with 3 boundary layers for coefh=1.0. For a moderately dense shear-thinning debris flow, density was set to 1700 kg/m^3 as requested, with matched rhop0 and phase_rhop, HBP_n=0.75 for shear-thinning, moderate consistency visco_nn=0.2, moderate yield stress tau_yield=0.02, and HBP_m=25 for smooth regularisation. Artificial viscosity was set to 0.1, output interval to 0.2 s, and total runtime to 10 s as requested. Use Symplectic as the step algorithm in the main DualSPHysics execution XML/settings outside this geometry/parameter block.

### Geometry XML
```xml
<geometry>
  <definition dp="0.5">
    <pointmin x="-2" y="0" z="-2" />
    <pointmax x="102" y="0" z="35" />
  </definition>
  <commands>
    <mainlist>
      <setshapemode>dp | bound</setshapemode>
      <setdrawmode mode="full" />

      <!-- Initial debris column from sketch: width 14.5 m, height 29.5 m -->
      <setmkfluid mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>solid</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="-1" z="0" />
        <size x="14.5" y="2" z="29.5" />
      </drawbox>

      <!-- Channel/tank boundaries from sketch: total runout length 14.5 + 85 = 99.5 m -->
      <setmkbound mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>bottom | left | right | front | back</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="-1" z="0" />
        <size x="99.5" y="2" z="31.0" />
        <layers vdp="0,1,2" />
      </drawbox>

      <shapeout file="" />
    </mainlist>
  </commands>
</geometry>
```

### Physics Parameters
  gravity_z            = -9.81
  rhop0                = 1700.0
  coefh                = 1.0
  cflnumber            = 0.2
  phase_rhop           = 1700.0
  visco_nn             = 0.2
  tau_yield            = 0.02
  HBP_m                = 25.0
  HBP_n                = 0.75
  Visco                = 0.1
  DensityDT            = 3
  DensityDTvalue       = 0.1
  TimeMax              = 10.0
  TimeOut              = 0.2
